question: An equilateral triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with centre O. D is a point on the minor arc BC and ∠CBD = 40º. Find the measure of ∠BCD.
solution:
**Given:**

An equilateral triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with centre O

∠CBD = 40º

**Concept used:**

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral = 180°

The sum of all three angles of a triangle = 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd821fb8f9914d76aa4fd5516e519dcdbd19791178630913449618217285dcbc.png] 

∠ABC = ∠ACB = ∠BAC = 60° [∵ ΔABC is an equilateral triangle]

Also, ∠BAC + ∠BDC = 180°

⇒ 60° + ∠BDC = 180°

⇒ ∠BDC = 180° - 60° = 120°

Also, ∠CBD + ∠BDC + ∠BCD = 180°

⇒ 40° + 120° + ∠BCD = 180°

⇒ ∠BCD = 180° - 40° - 120° = 20°

**∴ The value of ∠BCD is 20°**
